div.div: The test for a fake cursor: can the client compute the next one? cursor = last + pageSize is an offset wearing a cursor’s name — same drift, same O(N) scan.

div.div: A real cursor is opaque and minted by the server, because it encodes the sort key it is anchored to. If you can do arithmetic on it, nothing was fixed — the parameter was just renamed.

a.text: Text is not SVG - cannot display
